summary: Phase 8 group-booking PAYMENT MODEL resolved this session. Supersedes both prior framings: NOT 'deferred entirely' (the 2026-07-25 memory) and NOT the 'free-RSVP shell' (older .continue-here framing). The pricing model is now designed; group size affects price, so it no longer reads as 'free'.

resolved_design.single_payer: Organizer pays for ALL pax. Exactly one payment -> reuses the existing hold-until-session rail unchanged (no cost-splitting, no per-attendee collection). This is what makes it buildable.
resolved_design.two_axes: Pricing unit (per-space flat vs per-head) x Occupancy (exclusive vs open). These are independent; earlier discussion conflated them.
resolved_design.v1_scope: EXCLUSIVE-ONLY. Group booking = one exclusive lock on the space -> existing GiST exclusion constraint untouched.
resolved_design.open_play_deferred: Open court / open play (strangers share one slot, each pays per head) is a SEPARATE future product = GPAY-02 ticketing + a capacity-counter availability model that would BREAK the exclusion constraint. Do NOT build in v1.
resolved_design.unified_pricing_formula: total = baseRate + max(0, pax - included) * extraHeadFee. extraHeadFee=0 => flat court rental, zero leak, backward-compatible default (existing listings unchanged). included+fee => group size affects price, leak bounded to surcharge delta. 'per-person' = the extreme (included=1) => max under-declaration exposure, front desk is the enforcement. This is the Airbnb extra-guest-fee shape.
resolved_design.scope_reach: Reaches into Phase 2 (host sets base + optional included/extraHeadFee) and Phase 4 (quote applies the formula), but shallow + backward-compatible because extraHeadFee defaults to 0.

money_leak_analysis.crux: per-person-exclusive is the most-exposed cell: organizer declares pax=1, pays for 1, brings 4 (court is already theirs, no stranger blocked, only the front desk forces honesty).
money_leak_analysis.structural_truth: Leak is proportional to how much price depends on door-counted heads: per-space=0, surcharge=bounded, pure per-head=max. per-head-exclusive CANNOT be made self-policing without becoming ticketing (the deferred open-play model).
mitigations_settled: Structurally prefer per-space + surcharge (bounds exposure to the surcharge delta).
Host check-in headcount confirmation -> creates a discrepancy RECORD (v1 seam) + enables an in-app TOP-UP charge to organizer's saved card (top-up = fast-follow).
RSVP shell doubles as a fraud-corroboration signal (RSVP count vs declared pax mismatch = flag) -> gives invites a hard job beyond logistics.
Align host incentives so they don't prefer cash (payout / ranking / dispute protection flow only from on-platform bookings).
Accept the bounded remainder, priced into commission (every marketplace leaks at the last mile).

refund_no_show: Organizer bought the slots -> no per-attendee refund on no-shows. pax-decrease follows the Phase-7 cancellation ladder; pax-increase = capacity-checked top-up.

human_actions_pending.action: Pre-launch money-loop validation vs PayMongo test mode (payment -> confirm -> payout -> refund)
human_actions_pending.context: Separate track, unchanged. Never driven end-to-end. Card/GCash testable now (fixture booking 42132ab1 / pay_C4PW6fRGtUTNm6GsKCpt4P36); QRPh + payout blocked on PayMongo Money Movement beta.

decisions.decision: v1 group bookings = single-payer (organizer pays all pax), exclusive-only, reusing the existing payment rail
decisions.rationale: One payment sidesteps the cost-splitting complexity that got other models rejected; exclusive lock keeps the exclusion constraint intact

decisions.decision: Unified exclusive pricing: base + optional per-extra-head surcharge over an included headcount; extraHeadFee defaults to 0
decisions.rationale: Airbnb extra-guest-fee shape; makes group size affect price (answers the 'feels free' complaint) while staying backward-compatible and bounding the leak

decisions.decision: Open play / open court DEFERRED to its own future phase
decisions.rationale: = GPAY-02 ticketing + capacity-counter availability; would break the GiST exclusion constraint and needs per-attendee payment

decisions.decision: Per-person-exclusive under-declaration leak accepted as bounded-by-design
decisions.rationale: Cannot be made self-policing without becoming ticketing; mitigated via prefer-per-space, host check-in record + top-up (fast-follow), RSVP corroboration, incentive alignment, commission buffer
